schema_transition.evidence: Reviewed transition from the committed lineage through 012 to the committed lineage through 012-010-011, registering the two reserved additive Finder migrations required by the F3 cutover: 010_v3_system_search_body_type_counts.sql (adds body-type-count columns to v3_app.system_search) and 011_v3_system_archetype.sql (adds the system_archetype / system_archetype_summary product relations + insert-only lifecycle). The exact-prefix rule forbids inserting them ahead of the already-applied 012.
